scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w @sistema-ventas/api" "npm run dev -w @sistema-ventas/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sistema-ventas/api && npm run build -w @sistema-ventas/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:prod -w @sistema-ventas/api" "npm run start -w @sistema-ventas/web"
